measurement_boundary: Reading the task TSVs and cached image features, tokenising all splits, building the training-only vocabulary and encoding token ids. CodeCarbon machine mode measures the whole computer (idle desktop, display, other open programs); see the idle-baseline run.
reuse_notes: Reuses cached image features (alignment check only); text processing is cheap and repeated in memory, not cached.
notes: Text tokenisation is a data-dependent cost for the 10x/100x scaling analysis.
